title: Yoisaki Kanade — I'm Here, My Friend〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness I was able to get home before it started raining.

rows.Speaker: Ena's Message
rows.Line: <Kanade, Mizuki, are you both home already?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<I am!
I was just about to log onto Nightcord.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It might be faster for me to tell them on Nightcord...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Luka said she went over to tell you what happened with Mafuyu. Has she told you already?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. She said Mafuyu went home to talk to her mom...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <She apparently almost had her phone taken away, but I guess that sort of gave her the push she needed, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You mean whether she can properly tell her mom how she really feels?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You're worried about what Mafuyu's mom will do, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because up until now, Mafuyu probably just kept doing what her mom told her to do...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To put it bluntly, she's about to bite the hand that feeds her...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But she hasn't been able to say how she really feels all this time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Her having to keep quiet just doesn't seem right, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I get what you mean...
But getting her mom to understand is like a completely different problem altogether...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Mafuyu means the world to me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Ever since she was little, she's been a kind and polite girl... That's why I want to make her the happiest person in the world.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: It saddens me to see that you're misunderstanding my intentions, but I want you to know that I care about her deeply.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She claims that she cares about Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I'm having a hard time believing her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which begs the question... Will she even listen to what her daughter has to say?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We heard that you guys were home, so we came to see how you're all doing...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh? What's going on? Did Rin and Len come over?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Y-Yeah...
We were having trouble just waiting around...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<They're waiting in SEKAI...
Just in case they hear back from Miku and KAITO.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I guess we're all really worried.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She'll probably be okay since Miku and KAITO are with her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But each second feels like an eternity right now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Did the others feel the same thing I did when they spoke to Mafuyu's mom...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It was sprinkling before, but it's really starting to come down. How perfect for our current situation...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <For now, let's just believe in Mafuyu...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If she does end up needing our help...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We have to be there for her.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We'll also help in any way we can...>
